strings.name: Virat Kohli
strings.summary: Kohli progressed from Delhi youth cricket to India’s team and captained all three formats. Known for consistent scoring, run chases and fitness, he contributed to the 2011 World Cup and 2024 T20 World Cup wins and broke the men’s ODI century record. He retired from T20 internationals in 2024 and Tests in 2025 while continuing ODI and club cricket, with broad commercial influence.
